# Lumen Finishworks

> Owner-operated auto detailing, paint correction, ceramic coatings and headlight restoration in the Salt Lake Valley, Utah. Mobile (I come to you) or drop-off. Run by Johnny Trang, a scientist who measures before he works: paint is gauged before any polishing, every job is inspected under detailing lights, and every customer gets before and after photos.

- Website: https://lumenfinishworks.com/
- Phone / text: (385) 218-0990
- Email: johnny@lumenfinishworks.com
- Based in: West Valley City, Utah (service-area business; no storefront)
- Hours: open daily, 7 AM–5 PM
- Insured and owner-operated. Mobile or drop-off now; studio opening 2027.
- Service area: the Salt Lake Valley and nearby cities, including Salt Lake City, West Valley City, South Salt Lake, Taylorsville, Murray, Millcreek, Holladay, Cottonwood Heights, Midvale, Sandy, Draper, South Jordan, West Jordan, Riverton, Herriman, Bluffdale, Kearns, Magna, Bountiful, Centerville, Farmington, Lehi, Saratoga Springs, Eagle Mountain, American Fork and Park City. Travel fees apply only outside the core valley.
- Booking: get an itemized price for your exact year, make and model at https://lumenfinishworks.com/quote/ ; the price is confirmed at a walkaround before any work starts, and nothing is added without the customer's OK.

## Services

- [Detailing](https://lumenfinishworks.com/detailing/): interior, exterior or full detail in three levels — Refresh, Renew and Radiance — priced by vehicle type.
- [Paint correction & ceramic coatings](https://lumenfinishworks.com/paint-correction-ceramic-coating/): paint correction in three grades (every panel paint-gauged), multi-year ceramic coatings, and coatings for matte paint, vinyl wraps and PPF.
- [Headlight restoration](https://lumenfinishworks.com/headlight-restoration/): Grades I–III; Grades I–II carry a 1-year clarity warranty, Grade III (sprayed 2K clear) a 3-year clarity warranty.
- [Winter Salt Flush](https://lumenfinishworks.com/winter-salt-flush/): a degreasing undercarriage wash for road salt and magnesium chloride (frame rails, brake-line runs, suspension, wheel wells), leaving a thin corrosion-inhibitor film per the degreaser maker; the Trail Flush is the same wash for packed mud. Best after storms and at the end of salt season.
- [Glass & wheels](https://lumenfinishworks.com/glass-wheels/): glass, trim and wheel ceramic coatings, named by each maker's own durability rating.
- [Lumen Membership](https://lumenfinishworks.com/care-plans/): scheduled maintenance visits at a set discount per visit.
- [Powersports, boats & RVs](https://lumenfinishworks.com/powersports/)
- [Fleet](https://lumenfinishworks.com/fleet/): on-site care for work vehicles.
- [For real estate agents](https://lumenfinishworks.com/agents/): the Closing Gift Card (a Lumen eGift card in any amount; larger cards include one or two complimentary add-ons the client picks), and a first-visit offer on a membership for the agent's own car.
- [For pet businesses](https://lumenfinishworks.com/pets/): dog daycares, boarding, groomers, vets, trainers and pet stores; their clients get light pet hair removal free with any detail that includes the interior when they mention the business (one per detail), plus front-desk QR cards and van detailing quoted after one van. No commissions or referral fees.

## Good to know

- [FAQ](https://lumenfinishworks.com/faq/): deposits, weather, water and power, timing, kids and pets, coated/PPF/matte care.
- [The science](https://lumenfinishworks.com/science/): pH, decontamination, ceramic chemistry, and plain-language definitions of detailing terms.
- [About](https://lumenfinishworks.com/about/)
- Durability figures quoted on the site are the product makers' own ratings.
- [Gift cards](https://lumenfinishworks.com/gift-cards/): Lumen eGift cards in any amount, sent by email or text, with no expiration date, usable toward any service; redeemed by booking and mentioning the card. Order page: https://app.squareup.com/gift/MLJXDCE7SRF1A/order
- Payment: major credit and debit cards via Square; a deposit holds the date and comes off the final bill. Utah sales tax is added where it applies.
